lessons: Engine defect, not implementer: clutch/stages.py check_meta runs metafill.fill on every 'drifted' file after Implement. Any importer whose import line changed counts as drifted, so the Check stage rewrites its clutch:meta header and commits it as 'clutch(<stem>): meta'.

clutch/metafill.py fill (lines 110-115) always replaces `purpose` with the model's text and replaces `owner: engine` with the model's owner. That produced all 25 Review scope findings. clutch/meta.py refresh alone would change only verified/hash.

The retry cannot succeed: clutch/specs/implement.md step 5 forbids the implementer from editing a clutch:meta header, and Check would rewrite purpose/owner again on the next pass. A human must fix check_meta/metafill so a drifted-only file keeps its purpose and owner.

Alternative fix: have Review treat Check-stage meta commits as engine-owned. After either fix, rerun from the existing branch. Keep tests/drain_helpers.py, tests/unit/test_drain_helpers.py, the hub edits and the import rewrites, which Review found correct.
